title: CopperAndVanillaCraftingTweaks
description:
Adds crafts for shields, hoppers, shears, buckets and powered rails using copper.
Also makes powered rails, rails, chains (iron and copper) and all lanterns cheaper to craft. It was made on top of a vaniila tweaks crafting tweaks datapacks.
body:
Datapacks that was build on top of vanilla tweaks and add some changes related to copper crafts.
List of Changes:
**From VanillaTweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/picker/datapacks/
Added: Copper Powered Rails (made cheaper by me), Craftables w/ Blackstone, Craftable Blackstone, Dropper to Dispenser, Slabs conversion to blocks, cheaper stairs, cheaper trapdoors, Shapeless paper, bread and shulker boxes, Smeltable concrete powder, rotten flesh to leather, sandstone dyeing, stair conversion to blocks, uncraftable ice, uncraftable nether wart block, universal dyeing, wool unpacks to string

Added By ME:
Copper Buckets, Hoppers, Shears, Shields, Cheaper Iron and Copper Chains, Cheaper iron and copper lanterns,
